sample_unit: chatbot outputs (one standardized prompt per chatbot), rated by 7 experts

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot palliative care education content for ICU caregivers
links.effect: Readability scores were comparable between chatbots (12.96 vs 13.21), a level that suggests content above typical patient reading levels, though understandability (PEMAT-P) was 91.7%.
links.quote: ChatGPT and Gemini produced content of comparable readability (12.96 vs 13.21).

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the quality, readability, sentiment, and expert-rated accuracy/completeness of ChatGPT and Google Gemini responses for ICU caregiver palliative care education, without evaluating a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
